Ask the OpenChoreo team if their project is just Backstage, and they’ll tell you the portal is only the front door.

At WSO2Con in Austin, I spoke with OpenChoreo maintainers Lakmal Warusawithana and Sameera Jayasoma about what sets the project apart from Backstage, its journey from a closed WSO2 SaaS product to a CNCF Sandbox project, and how it’s built for an agentic world.

OpenChoreo is a Kubernetes-native, open source internal developer platform. Behind the Backstage portal, the team has built the control plane, data plane, and observability, all aimed at giving developers self-service.

Then the conversation turns to agents. OpenChoreo ships with MCP servers and persona-based agents for SRE, FinOps, and architecture work. When I asked whether a rogue agent could burn through two years of token budget overnight, they pointed to the platform’s guardrails: AI gateways and token rate limiting.

Watch the interview and read the accompanying blog post at 808labs.io.
